title: Multibeat cubic heartbeat asymmetry: an exploratory incremental cross-database prediction test
abstract: Adding a four-minus-one-beat normalized cubic RR-increment contrast changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by -0.00946 (source-and-target record bootstrap 95% [-0.02370, 0.00410]) beyond time-domain HRV and single-scale asymmetry. The registered incremental prediction criterion was not met; this study does not establish added predictive value.
